summary: The FP4-CSF contract reader takes the model family from the top-level model_type of multimodal configs
details: DeepSeek's multimodal config.json names the model at the top (deepseek_v41) and its text tower in text_config (deepseek_v41_text). The CSF contract reader looked at text_config first and stopped with "CSF config must name a supported model family" for such checkpoints; it now prefers the top-level model_type and falls back to text_config.
